title: Payment Record Reduction of the Return Fee — Kestrel Advantage Balloon
content:
A clean payment record on the Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract earns a reduction of the return fee. The record is the contract's balloon late charges and balloon returned payments dated in the 12 calendar months ending on the billing date.

| Late charges in the 12 months | Returned payments in the 12 months | Reduction of the return fee |
|---|---|---|
| None | None | USD 75.00 |
| Exactly one | None | USD 25.00 |
| Two or more | None | None |
| Any number | One or more | None |

A window of 12 calendar months ending on the billing date takes in the dates on or before the billing date that fall fewer than 12 whole calendar months before it; whole calendar months are complete each time the later date reaches the earlier date's day of the month, so a later date that falls earlier in its month (month-end included) leaves that month incomplete.

*Hypothetical:* billed on 3 March; a late charge dated 4 March of the previous year is inside the window, one dated 3 March of the previous year is outside it.
